action_items: Main agent: visually confirm rate-mix-weekly-card renders inside RateMixPanel and wash-pace-0/projected-0/forecast-0 testids appear when active blocks exist. Backend already returns correct data (verified). Likely low-risk (component-level, not data-level).
critical_code_review_comments: space_rms.py: `cap = await db.rooms.count_documents(pid) or 20` — inconsistent with rms_uplift.py which correctly uses room_types sum. Consider unifying capacity source.
space_rms.py apply endpoint: no protection for human-set overrides (unlike rate_mix apply which respects '@' / 'owner-override'). Robot can overwrite operator-set space rates silently.
los_wash_metrics.py compute_group_wash: fallback historical_wash_pct=25.0 when no past blocks — acceptable but should be documented as sector default in response (already noted in `note`).
rate_mix.py weekly loop uses find_one with $exists guard — good idempotency; snapshot upsert uses (property_id, week) which is correct.

success_rate.frontend: 50% verified visually (RMS Uplift + Function Space fully confirmed; Rate Mix Weekly card + Group Wash pace cells not visually confirmed — backend data OK)
